title: Mission 13: The Lockdown
story: The compliance sweep found the time bombs; now defuse them. Payroll is world-readable, the deploy script will not run, and a shared drop box lets anyone overwrite anyone. Permissions are the locks on every door in this building - chmod cuts the keys. Set each lock exactly to spec: too tight breaks the business, too loose breaks the news.

badge.name: The Lockdown: Keys Cut
badge.desc: Mastered chmod by setting every lock in the office exactly to spec - numeric and symbolic.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING13.txt in your department directory. lockdown/payroll.csv is readable by the whole building. Lock it to owner-only read and write: exactly 600.

checks.fail: payroll.csv is not mode 600 (owner read+write, nothing for anyone else).
payroll.csv content changed. chmod changes LOCKS, never contents.

tasks.brief: lockdown/deploy.sh will not run - it lost its execute bit. Give the OWNER execute permission using SYMBOLIC notation (the u+x family), leaving everything else exactly as it is (owner rw, group r, others r).

checks.fail: deploy.sh should end at exactly 744: owner rwx, group r, others r (add ONLY u+x to the 644 it started with).
deploy.sh still does not execute for its owner.

tasks.brief: The team must READ lockdown/team_report.txt but only YOU may write it; the rest of the building sees nothing. Exactly 640.

checks.fail: team_report.txt is not 640 (owner rw, group r, others nothing).

tasks.brief: The world-writable drop box the sweep flagged: lockdown/dropbox.txt at 666. Remove ONLY the write permission for group and others using symbolic notation (go-w). Everyone may still read it.

checks.fail: dropbox.txt should end at 644: strip write from group and others (go-w), keep everything else.

tasks.brief: Directories need execute to be ENTERED. lockdown/records/ was left at 777 - open house. Lock it to owner-only full access: exactly 700 (and understand why a directory needs that x).

checks.fail: records/ is not 700 (owner rwx only - the x is what lets you enter it).
records/index.txt changed. Lock the door; do not rearrange the room.

tasks.brief: Everything under lockdown/handouts/ (files at every depth) must be world-readable but writable only by you: 644 on every FILE in the tree, in one recursive move (chmod -R, or pair find with chmod if you want file-only precision).

checks.fail: handouts/welcome.txt is unreachable or not 644. If you ran chmod -R 644, the directories lost their execute (enter) permission and nothing inside can be reached: restore them with chmod 755 handouts handouts/week2, then set 644 on FILES only (find can touch only files).
handouts/week2/syllabus.txt is unreachable or not 644. The change must reach every depth, but FILES only - directories keep execute so they can be entered.

tasks.brief: lockdown/final_report.txt is signed and sealed: NOBODY writes it again, including you. Everyone may read. Exactly 444.

checks.fail: final_report.txt is not 444 (read-only for absolutely everyone).
deploy.sh's contents changed. A locksmith cuts keys; he does not rewrite the documents in the safe.

tasks.brief: BONUS: the shared lockdown/exchange/ directory needs the classic /tmp treatment: everyone may add files, but only a file's owner may delete their own (the sticky bit). Set exchange/ to exactly 1777.

checks.fail: exchange/ is not 1777 (777 plus the sticky bit - the same trick /tmp uses).
